Developed PowerShell and shell automation scripts for release orchestration and environment maintenance. Monitored cluster health and resource utilization on Azure Monitor, tuning autoscaling and node pools to control costs and maintain performance.

Used Terraform to codify cloud resources and CI templates for repeatable infrastructure provisioning across staging and prod. Containerized services with Docker and assisted teams with Dockerfile best practices and image scanning. Supported Linux-based systems and automated routine tasks with PowerShell and shell scripts.
